mentions.note: club 800m record 2:03.93, 6th in Commonwealth Games semi-final 2002

mentions.h: Girls at the Games - Commonwealth Games 2002
mentions.note: represented Wales; 800m 2:04.2 heat (4th), 2:03.93 semi-final (6th), Belgrave bests

photos.c: Top left: Emma Davies improved the club record for 800 metres to 2:03.93 when running to 6th in her semi-final at the Commonwealth Games in 2002. Here she is pictured taking maximum points over the same distance in the Jubilee Gold Cup Final.

Above: Representing Wales, Emma Davies reduced the Belgrave best for 800 metres twice at Manchester City Stadium. She was placed 4th in her heat with 2:04.2 and then clocked 2:03.93 to run to 6th in her semi-final.
